# PUT /api/v1/user/actions/secrets/{secretname}

Creates or updates a secret value in the user scope

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-130`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| secretname | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

**Request Body** (`application/json`) — `CreateOrUpdateSecretOption`

| Field | Type | Required | Validation |
|-------|------|----------|------------|
| `data` | string | True | max length 65536 |
| `description` | string | False | max length 4096 runes, truncated if longer |

## Response

**201** — empty

- **204** — Secret updated (already existed)
- **400** — Invalid secret name
- **404** — Not found
- **500** — Internal error

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Secret/variable names must match pattern ^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$ (case insensitive) | validation | Name does not match namePattern regex |
| Secret/variable names cannot start with GITEA_ or GITHUB_ prefix | validation | Name matches forbiddenPrefixPattern |
| Secret/variable name 'CI' is reserved and cannot be used | validation | strings.EqualFold(name, "CI") |
| Secret data cannot exceed 65536 characters | validation | len(data) > SecretDataMaxLength |
| Secret data is encrypted with setting.SecretKey before storage | business_logic | Always on insert/update |
